scripts.deploy:sandbox: node scripts/check-sandbox-deploy.mjs && node scripts/validate-iap-catalog.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.deploy:sandbox:dry-run: node scripts/check-sandbox-deploy.mjs --config-only && node scripts/validate-iap-catalog.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.d1:create:sandbox: wrangler d1 create kinic-payment-sandbox --binding DB --update-config --use-remote --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:sandbox: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrations:list:sandbox: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
